title: Module review
subtitle: Everything about Syrah
objectives: Compare the Rhône and the Barossa

steps.prompt: What gives Syrah its black pepper aroma?
Match each place to its Syrah.
steps.explanation: Each region shows a different side of the grape.

steps.prompt: Shiraz came originally from the Persian city of Shiraz.
steps.explanation: Not true. DNA shows it comes from south-east France.

steps.prompt: Penfolds Grange was first made in ____.
steps.explanation: Max Schubert's 1951 experiment became Australia's most famous wine.

steps.title: What you learned
points: Syrah gives dark fruit, pepper and smoky notes
The northern Rhône is its home; the Barossa its Australian icon
The names Syrah and Shiraz often signal style
It pairs with lamb, game and barbecue
